description:
A Super Top-up is an extension you can buy on your existing (or new) base health insurance cover.  
In this video, we have covered the best Super Top up plans offered in India.
We have compared the features, eligibility criteria , exclusions & also calculated the premiums.

SUPER TOP UP PLANS DISCUSSED :-
1. Niva Bupa Health Recharge
2. HDFC ERGO Medisure Super Top up
3. Aditya Birla Super Health Plus
4. ICICI Lombard Health Booster
